sections.takeaway: The v5→v7 bump is complete and consistent across all three uses, but the `check` CI job — the only one exercising this workflow's modified steps — is failing, so don't merge until that's understood.
sections.findings: - blocking (defect): .github/workflows/v1.yaml:24 — CI reports `check=failure`. The `check` job is the only one of the three that uses `fetch-depth: 0` (line 26) and it is the job the diff touches, while `isolation` (also on checkout@v7, no fetch-depth) reports `isolation=success`. I could not confirm whether the failure is caused by the v5→v7 bump (e.g. a change in how checkout v7 handles a full-history `fetch-depth: 0` fetch) or is pre-existing in the `npm test`/typecheck steps the diff does not modify. Please investigate the `check` log and confirm the failure is not introduced by the bump before merging.
sections.verified:
- Read the full diff: `git diff origin/main...HEAD` — exactly 3 lines changed, each `actions/checkout@v5` → `@v7`.
- Grepped the repo for `actions/checkout`: all three references in `.github/workflows/v1.yaml` (lines 24, 51, 94) are now `@v7`; no `@v5` references remain and there are no other workflow files. The bump is complete.
- Checked the workflow triggers (`push`, `pull_request` on `v1`/`main`): the v7.0.0 breaking change (block fork-PR checkout for `pull_request_target`/`workflow_run`) does not apply, since this workflow does not use either trigger.
- CI checks as reported by the harness: `image=skipped`, `isolation=success`, `check=failure`. `image` is skipped because it only runs on `push` (line 78), not `pull_request`.
sections.notes: - The change itself is a clean, well-scoped major bump; the only open question is the red `check` job.
